items.author: alice
items.quote: In general, a reader should fail loudly on input it cannot use
items.principle: A reader raises on input it cannot use rather than returning None.
items.rationale: a silent None turns into a wrong number three steps later.

items.author: alice
items.quote: Please raise on an empty table here instead of returning None.
items.principle: Raise on an empty table in this reader.

items.author: alice
items.quote: Keep the timeout for this one fetch at 30 s
items.principle: Every network call in the project times out at 30 seconds.
items.rationale: the upstream archive is slow on Mondays.

items.author: carol
items.quote: Units go in the column name so nobody has to guess them.
items.principle: A column's name carries its units.
items.rationale: so nobody has to guess them.

items.author: dana
items.quote: For future PRs: put the ticket key on the first line of the description
items.principle: A pull request description opens with its ticket key.
items.rationale: the release notes are built from it.
